identity.derivation: E_q[w R grad log p] = sum_a p_a (r_a - p_a) grad log p_a = sum_a (r_a - p_a) grad p_a; the micro-batch baseline's other samples give b sum_a grad p_a = 0 and its own sample removes 1/B; E_q[(1 / q) grad (r - p_a)^2] = -2 sum_a (r_a - p_a) grad p_a
